answer: Make rewards ripen slowly, the way juniper berries take a year or more on the branch. Each epoch's pay unlocks in 30 equal slices over the next 30 epochs, and unvested slices can't be staked, sold or moved over any bridge. If a later audit links IDs to one operator, every unvested slice in that cluster burns. A 100-clone farm caught after 20 epochs of steady pay forfeits about two thirds of what it earned. Honest agents bend like willow and wait; farms built for a fast cash-out lose most of their haul.
